geeklist.title: Auction, ends 11/17 -- includes trick takers and small-box games, some hard-to-find titles -- low SBs
geeklist.description:
[b][size=18] My second auction! Gotta get some Kallax space back. Rules below. Note that I will not accept offers outside the auction. [/size][/b]
1. BGG will get its 3%.
2. Auction will end around 5pm ET on Monday, November 17. To avoid sniping, I have secretly chosen a specific time in advance.
3. Items will ship within ~1 week.
4. I will use Pirate Ship for shipping. US only. It will be $6-10 for small games depending on your location, more for larger ones. My zip is 37415 if that helps you think about your likely shipping costs. If you win multiple games, I will of course combine shipping.
5. I'm open to local pickup, just let me know you're local when I message you about what you've won.
6. I will not accept offers below any item's starting bid (SB). All bids must be in increments of $1. Only Quest for the Lost Pixel has a soft reserve (SR). No BINs.
7. Talk to me if you want to delete a bid. I'd prefer you stick to what you post, but I understand that things happen.
8. If you don't provide payment within 48 hours of me confirming your win, I reserve the right to move to the next highest bidder. Payment will be via PayPal.
I am an established seller and trader on BGG and elsewhere! Rest assured that you'll get your games on time & packed well.
